tips.title: Welcome
tips.text: Use W A S D to move around.

tips.title: Instruction spawner
tips.text: This platform spawns instruction bricks. Stand next to it and press E to pick one up.

tips.title: The CPU
tips.text: Carry the brick here and press E to place it. It will process automatically.

tips.title: Deliver it
tips.text: Once processed, take the brick to the end platform. Press ? any time for help.
